articles.summary: Waza, the B2B payments and cross-border platform for emerging markets, has been granted an International Money Transfer Operator (IMTO) licence by the Central Bank of Nigeria. This milestone allows Waza to facilitate inward remittances into Nigeria, expanding its regulated financial services. With over $700M in annualized volume processed and a growing suite of global payment solutions, Waza is deepening its mission to connect African businesses to the global economy with faster, safer, and more affordable remittance and liquidity tools.
articles.title: Waza Secures IMTO Licence from the Central Bank of Nigeria
